baseline: ZenCad legacy geometry API on feature/migration, 2026-08-30

status_meaning.implemented: The private typed layer already provides the complete domain capability.
status_meaning.partial: A typed capability exists but legacy parameters, variants, or result semantics are incomplete.
status_meaning.missing: No truthful typed equivalent exists yet.
status_meaning.repair: The legacy entry is broken or conflicts with the accepted typed model and needs an explicit repaired contract.
status_meaning.unchanged: The entry remains supported outside the lazy/domain migration and needs no typed replacement.

scope: Factories and operations intentionally exposed from the zencad root.
Public methods of legacy domain values, transformations, Shape, Curve, Curve2, Surface, BoundaryBox, and wire_builder.
Mesh, conversion, and display boundaries that consume or produce domain values.
Imported OCP helpers and lazy proxy implementation classes accidentally leaked by star-import are excluded.

default.materialization: to_ocp() only at the native boundary

default.typed: typed sweep-law contract for {name}, tracked by #2036
default.materialization: native law only inside sweep evaluation
structured native data only at explicit boundary

sew.typed: Runtime.sew(Sequence[Edge | Wire]) -> Wire | Runtime.sew(Sequence[Face | Shell]) -> Shell

unify.typed: Runtime.unify() / Shape.unify() preserves the concrete topology handle

default.materialization: file/string I/O materializes the domain value

default.typed: display adapter accepting typed handles for {name}
default.materialization: display transport is an explicit materialization boundary

disp.typed: disp() accepts typed Shape, MeshData, and Point3

display.typed: display() accepts typed Shape, MeshData, and Point3
